entries.quote: ChatGPT Plus and ChatGPT Go users can send up to 160 messages with GPT-5.5 every 3 hours. GPT-5.5 Thinking has a limit of 3,000 messages per week.
entries.notes: 3h is a rolling window from first message. Falls back to mini model after cap. GPT-5.5 remains the current standard model as of this snapshot (GPT-5.2 was retired from ChatGPT on 2026-06-12; GPT-5.6 is in limited partner rollout). Re-verification limit: this help page sits behind Cloudflare and returns 403 to both plain and headed-browser fetch without a residential proxy, so it could not be re-read live on 2026-07-01. verified_on is 2026-06-29, the last date the automated source-watch (scripts/fetch.mjs, browser method) confirmed the page text unchanged by hash; the 160 msg/3h figure is independently corroborated by the OpenAI help-center summary surfaced 2026-07-01.

entries.quote: The ChatGPT Business and Pro plans offer unlimited access to our GPT-5 models, subject to abuse guardrails.
entries.notes: "Unlimited" subject to abuse guardrails; no published hard cap. GPT-5.5 Pro (research-grade) included. Cloudflare-gated page; verified_on 2026-06-29 = last automated hash-check confirmation (see Plus entry).

entries.quote: Everything in Plus and: 5x or 20x more usage. Maximum Codex tasks.
entries.notes: Distinct $100/month Pro tier. The official pricing page includes Codex and describes a 5x-or-20x usage range; this record is the 5x tier. No fixed message cap is published.

limits.quote: If your conversations are relatively short (approximately 200 English sentences, assuming your sentences are around 15-20 words), you can expect to send around 45 messages every 5 hours, often more depending on Claude's current capacity.

entries.quote: At least five times the usage per session compared to our free service.
entries.notes: Anthropic publishes a token budget, not a message count. Price $20/mo ($17/mo annual) re-verified on claude.com/pricing 2026-07-01. The ~45 msg/5h figure is an official estimate from the now-retired 'About Claude's Pro Plan Usage' article (id 8324991, live URL now 404); cited via the 2025-07-28 Wayback snapshot and tagged basis=estimate. It predates the 2026-05-06 Claude Code 5-hour doubling and may be stale for current chat. Pro is the 1x baseline for the Max 5x/20x multipliers.

limits.quote: If your conversations are relatively short and use a less compute-intensive model, with the Max plan at 5x more usage, you can expect to send at least 225 messages every five hours, and with the Max plan at 20x more usage, at least 900 messages every five hours, often more depending on message length, conversation length, and Claude's current capacity.

The 'at least 225 msg/5h' figure is an official estimate from the now-retired 'About Claude's Max Plan Usage' article (id 11014257, live URL now 404), cited via the 2025-09-10 Wayback snapshot; predates the 2026-05-06 Claude Code doubling.

entries.quote: Choose 5x or 20x more usage than Pro

entries.quote: Get 2x higher usage limits than Free
entries.notes: Confidence upgraded announced -> official: the $4.99/mo price (down from $7.99) and the 2x-vs-Free multiplier are now both shown live on the official gemini.google/subscriptions page, re-verified 2026-07-01. The drop was first announced via Google's Jun 8 2026 subscriber email (event google-aiplus-pricedrop-credits-2026) when public pages still showed $7.99; it has now propagated to the public page. Base 200 AI credits/mo were removed; Google uses a compute-based 5h + weekly usage model, AI Plus still 2x non-subscriber. No price-value change vs the 2026-06-08 snapshot (already recorded 4.99), so no changelog delta.

entries.quote: Get 4x higher usage limits than Free
entries.notes: Google moved from daily prompt counts to opaque compute-based limits (5h refresh + weekly cap), then adjusted them after May 2026 backlash. No published numeric cap. Price $19.99/mo and 4x-vs-Free multiplier re-verified on gemini.google/subscriptions 2026-07-01. Ultra multipliers are stated relative to Pro.

entries.quote: $99.99/month: 5x higher usage limits vs. AI Pro
entries.notes: Multiplier is official; absolute compute budget is not published. Lower of the two AI Ultra price points. Re-verified on gemini.google/subscriptions 2026-07-01.

entries.quote: $199.99/month: 20x higher usage limits vs. AI Pro
entries.notes: Price dropped from $250 to $199.99 in May 2026. Multiplier official; absolute budget not published. Re-verified on gemini.google/subscriptions 2026-07-01.

entries.quote: SuperGrok offers 1,000 messages and 50 images per day; on the standard plan you can send approximately 100 to 150 messages per four-hour window before being throttled.
entries.notes: 4h figure is a community midpoint of the 100-150 range. $30/mo or $300/yr. Not re-verified for 2026-07-01: xAI's own limits page (x.ai) is Cloudflare-gated (no_feed), and on re-check 2026-07-01 the cited community source (jingrey) had been rewritten to a per-feature format (images/video/voice/DeepSearch caps) that no longer states the 1,000/day message total, and it now lists SuperGrok Heavy at $80/mo. That single, internally-inconsistent secondary source is not enough to overwrite these figures, so the 2026-06-07 values and verified_on are carried forward unchanged pending a dedicated community/official re-verification. confidence stays community.

entries.quote: SuperGrok Heavy lifts the caps to 5,000 messages and 200 images daily; Heavy subscribers see roughly 250 messages per four-hour window.
entries.notes: Only consumer plan with full Grok 4.3 access. $300/mo. Not re-verified for 2026-07-01 (see SuperGrok note): the cited community source now shows a conflicting $80/mo Heavy price and a different per-feature cap structure with no daily message total, uncorroborated by any other source, so the 2026-06-07 figures and verified_on are carried forward pending dedicated re-verification. If a Heavy price cut is confirmed it would be a material change - flagged for follow-up.

entries.quote: Perplexity Pro includes approximately 500 Deep Research queries per day at average usage.
entries.notes: Pro users reported quiet limit cuts to advanced models in May 2026. Chat 'unlimited' applies to the UI, not API. Not re-verified for 2026-07-01: Perplexity's blog/hub is a JS-rendered site with no scrapeable source (no_feed), and secondary sources checked 2026-07-01 now cite a much lower Pro Deep Research allowance (~20/day) that conflicts with this 500/day figure. The sources disagree and none is authoritative, so the 2026-06-07 value and verified_on are carried forward pending a dedicated re-verification against Perplexity's own page. confidence stays community.

entries.quote: Perplexity Max includes the highest available limits across all features, plus 10,000 Perplexity Computer credits per month.
entries.notes: Exact daily query cap for Max is not published. $200/mo or $2,000/yr. Not re-verified live for 2026-07-01 (see Pro note); value is null/unpublished either way, so carried forward unchanged.

entries.quote: $20 of API agent usage
entries.notes: Two separate monthly pools: API agent usage (the $ figure) plus a non-numeric 'generous Auto and Composer usage' pool. On-demand usage billed in arrears after the included amount. Re-verified on cursor.com/pricing 2026-07-01 ($20/mo, $20 included API usage). The 2026-07-01 Cursor Teams pricing change (new Premium seat, split pools; event cursor-teams-pricing-premium-seat-2026) applies to Teams/Business seats, not this individual Pro plan, which is unchanged.

measured.notes: Realized consumption for one billing month, not a cap. The API pool ran ~$33 against a stated 'at least $20' floor: gpt-5.5-medium used 42.8% of the pool for 30M tokens; at the Pro+-validated rate of ~$0.47/M that is ~$13.9, implying a ~$33 pool. Other API-pool models aren't individually itemized on the Pro screenshot, so only the observed gpt-5.5-medium rate is listed; see Pro+ for the full per-model rate card (rates are model-intrinsic API prices, shared across plans). Auto+Composer hit 100% and overflowed 16.9M tokens into the API pool. ~95% of all tokens are subsidized Auto.

entries.quote: $70 of API agent usage
entries.notes: Plus a non-numeric 'generous Auto and Composer usage' pool. On-demand usage billed in arrears after the included amount. Re-verified on cursor.com/pricing 2026-07-01 ($60/mo, $70 included API usage). Individual plan unaffected by the 2026-07-01 Cursor Teams pricing change.

measured.source: Cursor dashboard, account-owner screenshot + usage CSV export
measured.notes: Updated replacement for the earlier Pro+ receipt, not a separate report. Cursor dashboard showed the Pro+ billing period May 10-Jun 08 fully maxed: Total spend $512.83, Included $512.83, On-demand $0, and the included pools at 100% Auto and 100% API used. The CSV export for the period contains 914.2M included tokens: 137.4M API-model tokens (claude-opus-4-8-thinking-high + gpt-5.5-medium) and 776.8M Auto/Composer tokens. The CSV also contains 21.3M Free tokens and 1.7M errored/no-charge tokens; those are excluded from the included monthly receipt. Per-model $/M rates are not listed here because this CSV labels rows as Included/Free rather than giving precise per-model dollar charges.
